method: Blind visual audit (scripts/07_audit_chips.py, threshold p>=0.9, SGL 43 test half). 30 random detections NOT matched to the reference were shuffled with 10 matched detections (positive controls) into an unlabeled 80 m chip grid; each chip was judged hearth / maybe / not-hearth before unblinding.
unmatched_not_hearth_types: road and trail junctions/turnouts, road cuts, stream banks and channel bends, ditches, field edges
note: Adjusted = measured + (1 - measured) * (unmatched judged hearth [5/30] .. hearth+maybe [7/30]). Single-rater, n=30: indicative only.
